description: This file defines an interface 'NestedSetInterface' used for representing nested set structures in an object-relational mapping (ORM) context. It specifies method signatures for getting and setting 'left', 'right', 'level' properties, and managing an associated node.

classes.name: NestedSetInterface
classes.description: Interface for nested set operations within an ORM, defining accessors and mutators for tree structure properties and a node reference.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the left index of the nested set node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left index of the nested set node.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the right index of the nested set node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right index of the nested set node.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node within the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level of the node within the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeInterface object with the nested set.
